svg.text: Production-ready · every component runs in Docker Compose

g.text: nginx:alpine serving the built React bundle
SPA fallback · hashed assets, long cache
File router: type detect · corruption check
Digital PDF: PyMuPDF (per page, text layer)
evidence quotes · null for unknown values
Decimal math: subtotal + tax = total, Σ items
LLM + embeddings, model set via env config
API key lives only in ai-service
Connection pooling for API replicas + workers

svg.text: React 18 · Vite · React Router · TanStack Query
1 React SPA → Nginx LB → one of N Node.js API replicas
2 API validates, stores original file in MinIO,
writes document row (status = queued) in PostgreSQL
3 API enqueues BullMQ job → returns 202 + jobId
4 Worker consumes job → Python service detects type
5 AI service calls OpenAI via circuit breaker
6 Validation engine flags needs_review → saved to DB
7 Progress: Redis Pub/Sub → API → SSE → UI
8 Failure: retries + backoff → DLQ → manual reprocess
• Load balancing: Nginx least_conn → API & UI replicas
• Circuit breaker opens on repeated OpenAI errors →
jobs delayed & retried; search falls back to keyword
• Rate limit + concurrency caps protect the LLM quota
• Page-level jobs: 1000-page PDFs run in parallel
